rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Use uppercase + wide spacing for overlines and small labels.
Font weights should be radical (e.g., Light 300 or Black 900) to create tension.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. High density, no soft shadows, 1px solid borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: border-collapse style layout. Very subtle rounded edges (max 4px) or completely sharp.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle glow on active elements using drop-shadow, no glassmorphism on main grid to maintain clarity.
visual_enhancers.micro_themes: Retro-Futurism touches for the terminal view (results detail), keeping the main editor crisp and distraction-free.

layouts.spacing: Dense but intentional. Use p-4 to p-6 inside panels. gap-px (1px) between grid panels to form a solid border grid.
structure: Full viewport height (h-screen) with overflow-hidden on body. Internal panels MUST scroll independently (overflow-y-auto).
Left Panel (col-span-3): Test Data Generator (Tabs for Simple/Advanced), Config.
Middle Panel (col-span-5): Code Editors (Your Solution, Correct Solution stacked vertically using flex-col h-full).
Right Panel (col-span-4): Results Dashboard & Diff Viewer.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm), flat background. Primary action 'Run Stress Test' should be high contrast. Hover states lift slightly or invert colors.
components.tabs: Minimalist. Text color changes, 1px bottom border highlights active state.
components.code_editor: Use Monaco Editor or CodeMirror with a dark theme (vs-dark equivalent). Syntax highlighting is mandatory. Integrated language selector in the editor header.
components.diff_viewer: Side-by-side or unified inline diff. Uses muted red/green backgrounds for deletions/additions (bg-red-500/10, bg-green-500/10) with text highlight.
components.verdict_badges: Small pill-shaped or sharp rectangular tags with solid background 15% opacity and bright colored text/border.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but override borders to be sharp. Input background should match surface color.

rules: Instant transitions for most dashboard elements (snappy feel).
Subtle fade for diff renders and tab switching.
Micro-animations on buttons (e.g. scale down 0.98 on active).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Code editors must use highly accessible syntax themes.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use a 2px solid ring matching the primary accent color.

instructions_to_main_agent.ui_library: Use shadcn/ui but heavily customize it. Strip away soft shadows and apply sharp, technical, dark-mode borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a technical, crisp look. Ensure it is installed.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., 'run-stress-test-btn', 'language-select', 'verdict-badge').
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: Create independent scrolling columns. Use CSS grid with 1px gap and bg-border to create the grid line effect naturally.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply global transition: all.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is BANNED).
Always apply explicit hover states with text and background color changes.
Ensure dark colors are used independently without muddy gradients.
Create depth through 1px sharp borders and z-index, not soft drop shadows.
No placeholder URLs for any images.
